It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1916 and earlier in the [[Philippine Assembly]] from 1907 to 1916.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 21, 2020 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district consists of the northern Batangas cities of [[Santo Tomas, Batangas|Santo Tomas]] and [[Tanauan, Batangas|Tanauan]], as well as adjacent municipalities surrounding the [[Taal Lake]]: [[Agoncillo, Batangas|Agoncillo]], [[Alitagtag]], [[Balete, Batangas|Balete]], [[Cuenca, Batangas|Cuenca]], [[Laurel, Batangas|Laurel]], [[Malvar, Batangas|Malvar]], [[Mataasnakahoy]], [[San Nicolas, Batangas|San Nicolas]], [[Santa Teresita, Batangas|Santa Teresita]] and [[Talisay, Batangas|Talisay]], a configuration that has been in place since 1987.{{cite web|title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm|publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library|access-date=April 10, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/constitutions/the-1987-constitution-of-the-republic-of-the-philippines/the-1987-constitution-of-the-republic-of-the-philippines-ordinance/|title=THE 1987 CONSTITUTION OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES – ORDINANCE|website=Official Gazette of the Republic of the Philippines|accessdate=August 18, 2023}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[King Collantes]] of the [[Nationalist People's Coalition]] (NPC).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 21, 2020}} Prior to its second dissolution in 1972, the third district encompassed the city of [[Lipa, Batangas|Lipa]] and the eastern Batangas municipalities of Balete, Laurel, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, [[Padre Garcia, Batangas|Padre Garcia]], [[Rosario, Batangas|Rosario]], [[San Jose, Batangas|San Jose]], Santo Tomas, Talisay, and Tanauan. The southeastern municipalities of [[Lobo, Batangas|Lobo]] and [[San Juan, Batangas|San Juan]] were also part of the district from its creation until 1928 when a minor reorganization, enacted into law a year earlier, transferred them to the [[Batangas's 2nd congressional district|second district]]. Simultaneously, Tanauan became part of this district.{{cite PH act|chamber=Act|number=3378|title=An Act Reorganizing the Representative Election Districts in the Province of Batangas|url=https://issuances-library.senate.gov.ph/legislative%2Bissuances/Act%20No.%203378|publisher=Senate of the Philippines Legislative Digital Resources|date=December 2, 1927|accessdate=November 11, 2023}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Legislature ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
